title: Concept: Framework SQL built from input (knex) — review required
description: In knex, knex.raw("SELECT " + c) mixes SQL text with values. ORM and helper layers pass interpolated text straight to the driver. The remedy is bound parameters via ? bindings.
applicability: knex data calls; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
